moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: You can create an entire company made of Grok Bots!
moments.why: It’s Musk suggesting AI bots could replace entire companies—a provocative vision sparking frenzy among tech-savvy men.

moments.author: MrBeast
moments.quote: My first 100 hours in GTA 6 is now live… thank you Rockstar for trusting us with playing the game early… daily GTA 6 videos…
moments.why: Beast announcing massive early-access playthrough of GTA 6—driving hype and envy among gamers.

moments.author: Cincinnati Zoo (via news)
moments.quote: Fiona the hippo has died at age 9 after ingesting a knit hat that accidentally landed in her habitat.
moments.why: The sudden death of beloved Fiona is trending broadly—even among men—because of the tragic absurdity and shared nostalgia.

moments.author: Vance (via news coverage)
moments.quote: “Can you let people enjoy GTA for like 5 seconds before you have to make it all weird?”
moments.why: Vance’s late‑night tweet trolling politicians jumping on the GTA 6 hype went viral—men love the snark.
